decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch draws on the firm's core seasonal craft and was once featured on the home page, so absent signs of shortfall it likely still meets aspirations, though its absence from the website since 2020 raises some uncertainty.
A one-tier pyramid is the firm's established product type built on existing routines, so there is no performance trigger for problemistic search even though it has not been observed recently.

The electronic music box is a declared flagship that management is committed to, and slack from industry growth lets the firm keep carrying it, but its distance from the core and lack of recent visibility make a shortfall against aspirations plausible.
This low-visibility accessory lies far from the core and is vulnerable, but it supports the flagship music box line and costs little to keep while that line continues.

This seasonal motif platform is a minor, distant add-on with little visibility, making a drop nearly as likely as not, but its link to the flagship and low resource needs still favor keeping it for now.
